claims.value: A 7B-parameter autoregressive language model fine-tuned for sentiment classification of user messages directed at a service, product, or agent. It generates a sentiment label (Negative, Neutral, or Positive) as the first token, followed by a short explanation. Built on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 and fine-tuned with reinforcement learning.
claims.evidence: Sentiment-Analysis-7B is a 7B-parameter autoregressive language model fine-tuned for sentiment classification of user messages directed at a service, product, or agent (the "Target").
